about_the_game:
When struck down while exploring, a jester wakes up at the edge of their digital world, in a strange place called Eden Station, plagued by rifts.

In VERIVENTURE, you can build, share and play dungeons online in the editor, created from over 50 level pieces. Near Eden Station, at the edge of the world, a labyrinthine oubliette lies dormant, hiding many enemies, puzzles, and secrets within its halls. From Eden, many other dungeons are accessible through trains that travel to player created levels, ancient remnants of a long ago era.

BUILD DUNGEONS

Shape your dungeons, built from rooms connected together on an endless grid. There are 50+ pieces for you to make levels within the editor, ranging across categories.

  • Layout pieces build the foundations of your dungeon’s design, like Doors, Trapdoors, and special Shapes.

  • Pickups are new items and abilities, or the containers that hold them.

  • Hazards act as an obstacle to the player.

  • Enemies are the components of a combat encounter.

  • Puzzle pieces create networks of signals and conditions the player must solve.

  • Decorative pieces add a finishing flair, or draw attention to a certain spot.

CREATE INTERACTIONS

Stack a level piece on another to create combinations of objects. Place an item within a chest, or spawn waves of enemies from a trap.

Open the context menu to set object's special properties, or connect them together to create puzzles or circuits.

SHARE WHAT YOU MAKE

Upload your dungeons online to be played by others, or search for dungeons that others have made to play yourself.

EXPLORE EDEN STATION

Just outside the Oubliette, at the edge of the digital world, lies Eden Station, allowing travel to all of the online levels. Become an adventurer and scavenge through lost domains that hold abandoned dungeons, all one train ride away.

VENTURE INTO THE OUBLIETTE

Explore, map out, and overcome multiple dungeons connected to one another through a network of rifts.

pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Additional Notes: Solid State Drive

short_description: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.
